Binance is set to list three new memecoins: Neiro (NEIRO), Turbo (TURBO), and Baby Doge Coin (100000BABYDOGE). These memecoins are based on the Ethereum network and are seen as the next generation of Dogecoin, drawing inspiration from Neiro, Atsuko Sato’s Shiba Inu dog.
